requirements.goal: Split physics out of game-core into its own crate(s) with a backend-agnostic trait, add a retro/arcade physics backend alongside rapier2d, and let entities pick their backend per-spawn so a scene can mix both
requirements.constraints: No cross-engine collision: rapier2d-backed and retro-backed entities live in two independent, non-interacting simulation worlds (no shared contact/narrow-phase). Preserve existing rapier2d behavior and tuning (contact stiffness, clamp-against-contacts) unchanged. Follow docs/code-style.md (one type per file, submodule+tests.rs pattern, per-crate README) and docs/structure.md dependency rules.
requirements.done: game-core physics code is split into dedicated crate(s) under core/ behind a PhysicsBackend-shaped trait; a retro backend exists and is selectable; EntityOp::Spawn (or equivalent) lets a caller pick rapier vs retro per entity; GameCore routes spawn/tick/despawn/collision to the correct backend instance; existing tests pass and cover the retro backend; docs (structure.md, a new ADR if warranted) updated
requirements.outOfScope: Cross-engine collision/momentum transfer between backends. Changing rapier2d tuning/behavior. New gameplay features beyond what the retro backend needs to be usable (no new EntityOp fields beyond backend selection unless required).

increments.description: New core/physics crate: PhysicsBackend trait, opaque BodyHandle/ColliderHandle newtypes, BodyKind, contact-query result types. No implementation yet, no game-core wiring. Crate builds standalone with a README.

Port current core/game-core/src/physics.rs verbatim into core/physics-rapier2d, implementing PhysicsBackend. Same tuning constants, same step/collision/contact-normal behavior, only the API surface changes shape to match the trait. Existing physics/tests.rs behavior ported and passing.

game-core depends on core/physics + core/physics-rapier2d only (rapier2d dependency removed from game-core Cargo.toml). Collider/GameCore use PhysicsBackend/opaque handles instead of rapier2d types directly. Still exactly one world (rapier2d), behavior unchanged. All existing game-core tests pass unmodified in behavior.

New core/physics-retro crate implementing PhysicsBackend: velocity-integrated AABB movement, no mass/impulses/solver, axis-separation contact resolution. Standalone unit tests for movement and collision resolution. Not yet wired into game-core.

increments.scope: game-core: multi-world registration and priority resolution
increments.description: GameCore owns one PhysicsWorld per backend plus a fixed priority list. EntityOp::Spawn wire format gains a world-membership field (bones-messages). Collider holds one handle pair per world. Per-tick: each world steps fully; for multi-world entities, Transform is read from the highest-priority world and other worlds copies are snapped to match before next tick. New tests cover single-world (unchanged), retro-only, and dual-world priority + snapping behavior.

Update docs/structure.md (game-core row/dependency graph now names core/physics, core/physics-rapier2d, core/physics-retro), each new crates README.md, and roadmap.md if warranted. ADR-021 already recorded in DESIGN.
